title: El Grande Americano vs. El Grande Americano
summary: Two men claim the same identity. A mask match reveals Chad Gable, and the rivals go on to pursue different championships.

chapters.title: The first El Grande Americano debuts
chapters.result: El Grande Americano defeated Dragon Lee.
chapters.context: The masked character’s debut provides the background to the later fight over the identity.

chapters.title: The mask continues with a new wearer
chapters.result: El Grande Americano defeated Dragon Lee.
chapters.context: A loaded headbutt secured the victory. Ludwig Kaiser had taken over the character following Chad Gable’s injury.

chapters.title: Je'Von Evans vs. El Grande Americano
chapters.result: Je'Von Evans defeats El Grande Americano (w/Bravo Americano & Rayo Americano) (12:32)

chapters.title: Dominik Mysterio vs. The Original El Grande Americano
chapters.result: Dominik Mysterio (c) defeats The Original El Grande Americano (9:04)

chapters.title: The mask comes off
chapters.result: El Grande Americano won the Mask vs. Mask match.

chapters.title: Chad Gable vs. Penta
chapters.result: Chad Gable defeats Penta (c) (11:05) - TITLE CHANGE !!!

chapters.title: El Grande Americano becomes Mega Champion
chapters.result: El Grande Americano won the AAA Mega Championship.
